fun maxPageSize(): UInt
fun clamp(value: UInt, low: UInt, high: UInt): UInt
class NumbersClient {
    fun list(pageSize: UInt? = null): Flow<Page<contract.sdk.v1.Numbers.Number>>
}
class WidgetsClient {
    suspend fun getWidget(id: String): contract.v1.Widgets.Widget
    fun listWidgetParts(widgetId: String, pageSize: UInt? = null): Flow<Page<contract.sdk.v1.Widgets.WidgetPart>>
    fun batchGetWidgets(ids: List<String>): Flow<List<BatchItem<contract.v1.Widgets.Widget>>>
}
class EventsClient {
    fun watch(ticks: UInt): Flow<contract.v1.Events.Tick>
}
